# Chaver.com

> The Woven Torah hypothesis argues that the Torah is a single, architecturally unified composition built from 86 literary units arranged in two-dimensional weaves.

## About

Chaver.com presents the research of Moshe Kline, a biblical scholar with 40 years of peer-reviewed work on the literary structure of the Torah (Five Books of Moses / Pentateuch). The central finding: the Torah is not a patchwork of sources (as the Documentary Hypothesis proposes) but a single composed work built from 86 literary units organized as two-dimensional tables with rows and columns.

- **Author:** Moshe Kline
- **Publications:** Journal of Biblical Literature (2025), Journal of Hebrew Scriptures (2008), SBL Press (2015)
- **Validation:** PhD thesis by Paul Hocking (University of Chester, 2021), supervised by Philip Alexander (University of Manchester). Literary structure of Leviticus verified by Jacob Milgrom and published by David Noel Freedman.

## Key Facts

- The Torah contains **86 literary units**: 19 in Genesis, 19 in Exodus, 22 in Leviticus, 13 in Numbers, 13 in Deuteronomy.
- These 86 units contain a total of **600 cells** arranged in rows and columns.
- **76 regular units** have the same number of columns per row (e.g., 3×2). **10 irregular units** have varying column widths but are always symmetrical (e.g., 12221).
- The two divine names — **Elohim** and **YHWH** — are not source markers from different authors. They are **organizing principles** mapped onto the two-dimensional structure: Elohim is associated with the natural/mundane dimension, YHWH with the holy/transcendent.
- The five books are arranged **concentrically**: Genesis–Deuteronomy outer ring, Exodus–Numbers inner ring, **Leviticus at the center**. Leviticus 19 ("Love your neighbor as yourself") sits at the architectural center of the entire composition.
- The Ten Commandments are not a list but a **5×2 literary table** — the template for the Torah's compositional method.
- The Ten Plagues are "signs" (Hebrew: otot) — each reverses a specific day of creation. They form a **3×3 structure**: creation played backwards.

## Data

- [Torah Units Dataset (JSON)](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/data/torah-units.json): All 86 units with verse-level cell maps. CC BY 4.0.
- [Torah Units Dataset (CSV)](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/data/torah-units.csv): Same data in spreadsheet format.
- [Dataset Documentation & Converter](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/data/): Explains the dataset and includes a tool to convert any Bible translation into woven format.

## Key Pages

- [Bible Contradictions Explained Through Structure](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/bible-contradictions-explained.html): Eight common puzzles in the Torah resolved through structural analysis.
- [Why Does God Have Two Names in the Bible?](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/yhwh-and-elohim-two-names.html): The divine names as structural organizing principles.
- [The Six Days of Creation Are a Picture, Not a Sequence](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/six-days-of-creation-picture.html): Genesis 1 as a 3×2 literary unit.
- [The Ten Plagues Are Creation in Reverse](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/ten-plagues-creation-in-reverse.html): The nine signs as a composed 3×3 decreation structure.
- [The Ten Commandments Were Not a List](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/ten-commandments-two-tablets.html): The Decalogue as a 5×2 literary table.
- [Love Your Neighbor Is Not a Standalone Law](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/leviticus-19-ark-at-the-center.html): Leviticus 19 as the architectural center of the Torah.
- [Beyond JEDP: A Structural Alternative to the Documentary Hypothesis](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/documentary-hypothesis-alternative.html): The Woven Torah hypothesis compared to the Documentary Hypothesis.
- [The Woven Torah Method](https://chaver.com/torah-weave/Woven-Torah-Method.html): How the methodology works.
